name: TOGAF EPIC v6 - engineered architecture document (full C4, complete robustness, workflow triad)
description: Contract for scripts/togaf_epic_v6.py. Stands on v5 (per-section Cypher retrieval + width walk) and v3 (TOGAF skeleton + citation gate), and fixes what made v5 read as a collection rather than a document: a shared diagram engine with size budgeting and sharding; a complete C4 hierarchy L1-L4 with drill-down; ICONIX robustness over EVERY classified object instead of the top-90 sample; per-workflow BPMN + UML sequence + robustness built from each contract's REAL DAG (plan.tasks/edges/waves); and total component coverage. Diagrams are rendered deterministically in code - the model never authors mermaid - because the PDF gate requires every block to render AND to fit the printable box.
doctrine: The TOGAF skeleton is a FLOOR: the planner may extend a chapter, never drop a prescribed artifact.
Width chapters are INVENTORIED, not planned - the index is a function of the estate, so the document cannot drift from what exists.
Robustness covers EVERY Class/File entity. v3/v5 sampled the top 90 of 2,438 (3.7%) and drew 14 per category; a sample is not a model.

Workflow diagrams come from the contract's real topology (plan.tasks/edges/waves). Unordered sets (model rosters, agent lists) must NOT be given invented sequence edges - they are parallel and BPMN shows them that way.
The model NEVER authors mermaid. Code renders every diagram from a node/edge set through one budgeted renderer that shards past 34 nodes.
A diagram that overflows the printable box overlaps body text, so svg_over_tall == 0 is part of the PDF gate, not decoration.
Every classified object carries a stable catalog ID (B-nnn/C-nnn/E-nnn) used identically across diagrams, per-component views and catalogs, so an object is trackable between views.
A section that retrieved nothing says so rather than inventing detail.

gates.per_section: words >= word_floor AND >=1 citation AND a References block AND no invalid citation labels
gates.pdf: svg_rendered >= mermaid_blocks AND svg_errors == 0 AND svg_over_tall == 0
gates.reported: a per-section table of words/citations/rows/diagram/query status is emitted into the document itself

metadata.skeleton_mode: --skeleton-only builds the complete deterministic spine (all diagrams, catalogs, C4 levels) with no LLM narrative, in about a minute
